title: 题材内容新颖！玩法数值稍需优化
body: 在读博士生拿了解压的小游戏，非常喜欢！很上瘾！！很推荐来感受一下！优点很多就不一一说了。想稍微提点建议：1释放分数线和学费的调整权限，分数根据高考、硕士考试和博士考试的实际情况设定上限，学费金额本科不超过5w，硕士不超过3w，博士不超过2w。而不是由系统决定体验会更好。2增加硕导博导的资格考试，要求能力多少以上参与过多少项目才可以申请。3增加老师招聘机制可以由玩家自行选择非升即走、短期聘用、长期聘用三种，聘用年限由玩家选择。聘用方式的差距可以使老师能力提升速度产生差异，非升即走的工资要翻倍，短期1.5倍，长期原工资。4增加社会科研院，可以把项目和社会建设挂钩，比如电影可以研发电影拍摄制作，学校可以自行投资。园林、哲学等专业的老师可以参与zf政策的指导之类的。5可以通过付费开通“交叉研究”，玩家可以自行开创研究所，安排不同专业的老师进行研究，根据不同参与的专业会出现不同的科研结果。这个可能要稍微费点劲，但是绝对增加可玩性6调整一下盈利数值，我现在体育场盈利几千万，别的都只有几百万，差距好大！

title: 希望作者保持这样的简洁和高级的ui界面别被评论带偏
body: 我发现很多评论说增加什么时间筛选功能 能细到观看每天的路径 还有说增加什么分享和排名 增加好友功能 还有软件内地图旋转 比例尺巴拉巴拉 ……我说真的 求求别这样 现在的ui界面和功能就是最完美的 不要向国内软件学习 搞一堆乱七八糟的没用的功能加广告 就纯粹一个世界迷雾主题性很明确的软件 我个人觉得现在的ui和功能真的已经很丰富和完美了 至于那些评论的用户 我推荐你们用一生足迹 或者 灵感足迹 他们完美符合你们的审美 他们可以每天看每月看每年看 甚至还有年总结报告 还可以把图片定位加进去  甚至还有游记笔记功能 就差短视频功能加进去了……当然 我相信作者的审美 非常感谢有这样一个软件 如果地图精度能提升  比如有些地方标准和混合是不在一个位置 在就是耗电能再少一些 还有最新加的图层颜色区分能在高级点就好了 感觉这配色还是随意了一些

title: AI平权真正的实施者
body:
直到今天，豆包依然是所有LLM中语音输入最精准、最方便的，没有之一。我的父母是70后，没用过电脑，手机也是00年后才买的，用智能机就更晚了，所以他们打字很不方便，而豆包完美解决了这个问题。
另外，豆包亲切的形象显示，也让老一辈用户更容易接受，不会觉得好像在搞什么很难学的东西，心理没有负担。
最后，豆包的语音反馈也是做的最好的，亲切的声音，自然的语气，甚至还适配了部分方言，更加让老一辈用户觉得好用、爱用。
感谢豆包，让我的父母享受到了科技进步带来的生活便利。

title: 言語切り替え、内容等
body: アプリ自体は操作が簡単で、優しい内容。タイマーブーストという10分間勉強して手に入れるXPを3倍にしてくれるようなものが手に入ったりするが、勉強を急かされて今やらないと、と思ってしまうことが多く、タイマーブーストを好きな時に使えるようにストック機能を追加して欲しい。super ファミリープランお試しの解約方法が分かりづらい。途中で「〜〜語で入力して下さい」のようなものが出るが、基本英語や日本語しか言語を使えないのでいちいち切り替えるのが困難。タイマーでチャレンジできるものもあるが、今説明したようなものが出ると何も出来ずチャレンジ失敗に終わる。それ以外は配慮されており、使いやすく言語も豊富でとても良い。

title: 第六感が必須？！
body:
▼スペイン語を始めました。問題に「“こんにちは”をスペイン語に訳せ」と書かれてるのですが、正解が「buenas tardes」の時と「hola」の時があります。日本語訳が同じなら、どちらも正解にするか、もしくは“問題に正解するための訳”、たとえばholaの方を「やあ」にするなどして区別していただかないと正解できません。
▼No, Pablo solamente es mi amigo.の日本語訳が日本人には理解できません。あまりにも変な日本語でしたので、翻訳アプリでそのスペイン語を訳してもらい、やっと意味がわかりました。超初級ですらこんな変な訳が付いてるので、今後複雑な言葉遣いになった時に、正しいスペイン語を学べるか非常に不安です。

title: カスタマーサポートが終わってる
body:
配送時に何度も問題があり、その都度システム上キャンセル・返金が可能だったため、実際に問題があった注文について返金を申請していました。

今回も長時間の配達遅延によって商品が冷めていました。
しかし、過去の返金が「過剰」と判断されたとして、アプリからの問い合わせ・補償機能を制限され、電話での問い合わせのみとなりました。
問い合わせても、今回の返金については拒否されました。

こちらとしては、配送時の問題について適切に対応してほしいと問い合わせているだけなのに、配送や商品の問題を解決するのではなく、利用者側の返金履歴を問題視して扱われているように感じました。

さらに、返金できない具体的な理由について質問しても、「利用履歴等を総合的に判断している」という回答ばかりで、今回の注文がなぜ返金対象にならないのかという質問には、最後まで明確な回答がありませんでした。

電話では「返金するには商品を回収する必要があり、回収できなければ返金できない」と説明されましたが、案内された規約には「返金後に商品を回収することができる」と記載されており、返金のために必ず回収が必要とは書かれていません。しかも、過去に返金された際には商品を回収されたことはありません。

また、商品を回収するという案内をされたのは、問い合わせから3日後でした。3日後まで商品を保管している利用者がどれだけいるのでしょうか。
そして、誰が回収して何を確認するのでしょうか。
それについても回答はありませんでした。

問い合わせるたびに、
「配達は正常に完了している」
→「利用履歴を総合的に判断している」
→「返金が過剰なので制限している」
→「商品を回収できないので返金できない」
と説明が変わり、最終的には「これ以上回答できない」と打ち切られました。

配送や商品の問題が実際にあった場合に、利用者が補償を申請することまで問題視され、肝心の質問にも答えてもらえないことに非常に疑問を感じます。
何のためのカスタマーサポートなんだろうと思いました。

私は今後二度と利用するつもりはありません。
少なくとも、問題が発生した際に利用者が納得できるよう説明し、きちんと対応するのがカスタマーサポートだと思います。

他の方のレビューを見る限り、カスタマーサポートはこういう運用でやっているのだなと感じました。

改善する気も利用者の問い合わせを聞く気もなく、このような不愉快な対応をされたカスタマーサポートは初めてでした。
レビューに回答されてますがそのカスタマーサポートが問題の根源なので案内そのものが無意味です。

皆様もお気をつけください。

title: Good, but….
body:
Good app, just keep in mind its limitations.  Often, it will not show sleep disruptions even though I know I was up for almost 30 minutes.  If you’re not moving and resting it can mistake that as sleeping.  On multiple occasions when sitting and driving a two hour trip it registered me as sleeping.  So, good app, yes, with limitations.

Worth $40 per year for the premium version…not even remotely close.  I was an annual subscriber when it was $20 per year (as I wanted to support the developer) but once the subscription cost doubled, to $40 per year, I cancelled and never went back.  Too bad, though, at $20 per year I would have “let it ride” in perpetuity.  At the new cost…no, not even if it was $30.  $20 was the sweet spot.  If it ever goes back to $20 per year, I’d sign up again.  Otherwise stick with the free option or look elsewhere.

title: EReceipt system misses a lot
body: The app itself is not bad if you’re doing paper receipts, you can get great points and everything, but the emailed or digital receipt system is awful. It only really works if you have a connected account. If you connect your email and try to get a bunch of your receipts done there, you can only have the system scan it through the app. That system no matter how many times you remove and add the email again ignores half of the receipts that you actually receive and there is no way to get points for those receipts because there is no forwarding system to get an actual human to look at it or to manually upload them to the system. So if you get something from a fast food place, or a small business, or sometimes even the ones that you might have a separate account for that is connected to fetch; you can believe that those receipts are going to be missing and there is no way to get points for them.

title: WOW!
body: That's probably a good place to start. The integrations with Apple Notes and Reminders is finally on its way. I have not tried all of the to-do apps available on the app store, but I have tried most of the big ones - ToDoist, TickTick, MS ToDo, Things3, several newer ones, and of course, Reminders. Things3 has made some recent improvements that kick it up a notch, and I continue to really like that platform for getting things done - simple and elegant. 2Do is a unique workflow and takes a little getting use to, but, I've been using it for the better part of nine-plus years and there's something that keeps me coming back. My biggest complaint is that it's so difficult to find on the app store, that's probably on Apple's traditionally terrible search engines. It is a very elegant app and wonderful to use if you make a personal connection with it. I would also argue it's one of the more beautiful developments in this category as well. A huge leap forward for 2Do is the ability to use iCloud natively. This was possible before the release of v.4, but the tradeoffs were not great ... not an issue anymore, you get it all on iCloud. A couple of final observations: Syncing has become more idiosyncratic - updates don't happen as predictably and instantaneously as they use to. On macOS, if the app is hidden, it will often not update until I bring it to the front, and even then I often hit the sync button at the bottom of the window to get it to actually update. (I have made sure that all of my sync settings are where they should be.) I don't think this will be an ongoing issue as I see there  has been several recent updates addressing this issue, including an update that further addressed the issue right after I downloaded it. And finally, the online instructions are a bit ambiguous to me - It's clear enough on how to set up syncing with Reminders, but I'm not clear on what I do after that initial sync. Do I go back to iCloud syncing, or do I have to choose between staying with Reminders sync or iCloud sync? That's it for now, I'll post updates as we go through a major OS update, and as this new version of 2Do gets smoothed out.

title: I’ve been using this app for 10 years.
body:
The quality and structure of this app has taken an extreme nosedive in the past few years into a greedy, predatory, ad-filled, micro-transaction-filled, ai-assisted, bloated, and unoptimized mess. This app used to be simple and free— ai and subscription services weren’t shoved down every nook and cranny. CapCut’s backend has slowed to a snail’s pace in exporting & editing and the export function will auto-select “ai up scaling” every time you go to export a video— forcing that you get an ad or reminder to buy a subscription. 

This app felt like it used to care. But I just feel like I’ve been spat in the face.

title: Tints every site, but I have to turn it off often.
body:
Pros. I haven’t found a website it won’t tint! The setup and customization is easy & makes sense. Con’s. This app may be limited to users seeking high customizability & who want to tint websites without loosing their individual aesthetics. After following the setup prompts to the T I’ve found safari to be running much slower. Some visual & functional elements can get blocked which also seems to exacerbate the slowdown. I find that on websites with custom scrolling behaviors, moving art & transitions that at times this app just covers much of that that in the background color but isn’t able to effectively tint the type in order to make it legible. I find I’m constantly turning it off to let websites load images and content, or sometimes when using Shopify stores being unable to click store buttons when it is enabled. Also as it doesn’t have an option to tint web links I find it just makes search engine results feel more cluttered as links are still bright blue instead of the desired theme. 
I may be more picky than most when it comes to these things. Overall one of the better dark screen options for safari on iPhone. I’m glad this was less than $5 and think it has value at the price just don’t expect pure magic. Thanks for making this app :)

title: Switched from another paid extension
body:

I was using one for years that worked pretty well but the dev did minimal updates and it started having a ton of issues.. been using Noir for many months now and it seems much better so far and you can tell the developer takes pride in their work, happy to see frequent improvements over time that add useful features and fix bugs.

Most importantly the dark theme it generates for websites look excellent and nearly native, without big slowdowns and crashes that I’ve experienced with others. The only minor issue has been that it falsely detects native dark modes sometimes, but I see a reporting tool has been added and it’s easy to override this as well. Lastly I’ll mention the interface is attractive and simple within safari and has some advanced features I’ll definitely make use of, great work! Highly recommended.

title: Easily worth $5

The Jesus Christ of Apps.

What I’m saying is that this app is easily worth $5 if you have $5 to spare. I did, and now I have a very useful app. I even subscribed to Filtr, and I’m not sure I have any use for it. Just wanted to support the creator, who, sticking with my previous analogy, would be like Mary Magdalene—or whichever of the Mary’s was Jesus’s mother. That’s always been confusing to me (and I’m too lazy to look it up before not proofreading this review). 

If you aren’t convinced by now, then I lack the adequate vocabulary to convince you. If you are convinced, make sure to leave a nice review for this indie developer. Thoughtful consumerism and all.

title: Exceptional Raw Data
body:
I’ve been using RadarScope since its inception back in 2008, and I’ve been consistently impressed with how far it has come over the years. The progression in available features, performance and overall capability has been remarkable, all while remaining reasonably priced for what it offers.

This is my go-to app for tracking storms in real time. Whether I’m looking at precipitation intensity, velocity data, or correlation coefficient, the level of detail on this mobile app is outstanding. It provides the kind of information you’d expect from professional grade tools, right in your hand.

In my opinion, there simply isn’t another mobile weather app that matches RadarScope in terms of capability, reliability and depth of data. If you’re serious about weather, this app is hard to beat!

title: Pause Advertising Ruined This App
body:
I asked 3 AI platforms if there's a way to keep the new and foolhardy Pause Advertising "feature" from popping up on Paramount+. All three said, "No."

I will often pause the TV, for example while watching Blue Bloods, to look at a New York City skyline to identify buildings and landmarks. Paramount's new "In-Promotion Experience" advertising, aka Pause Advertising, jumps up in the middle of the screen, and often blocks what I'm trying to look at while the video is paused. When I follow the on-screen directions, to "Press Any Button" to resume playing, the video action returns and I no longer see the frozen screen I wanted to see.

This is horrible and something new on Paramount+.

They took a decent app experience and turned it into a profit-centered playground for the bean counters and silly programming teams who are probably directed to increase advertising revenues any way they can. 

How's this for profits? When my subscription is up for renewal, I'll simply turn off Paramount+ and activate Netflix.

title: I have used Vinted for about 90 days
body: I had approx 45 sales in 30 days. I definitely  make a few bucks less than on eBay or mercari BUT an 8$ sale on Vinted is an 8$ sale as opposed to a 30$ eBay sale minus eBay fees minus postage. Now, this is what absolutely sucks about Vinted. The preferred shipper SpeedX is unreasonably slow! 10 day+ deliveries. Vinted sends WAY too many emails and they do not let you change preferences. Vinted does not allow you to turn off the ‘make an offer’ feature. Customer service is AI and dreadful to “communicate” with. I have had multiple items flagged by AI, the AI is inconsistent with flagging, and the AI is then merciless with penalties. I have appealed violations then when i got the reply, the violation reason changed thereby wasting my appeal. Vinted does not allow edits while the AI is processing a new upload. SO, if i realize i made an error, I cannot fix it. IF in the meantime the AI finds that error I get flagged for something i could have fixed!! Vinted has photo and listing policies that are not inline with ebay and mercari etc so be prepared for that. Vinted app does not have the variety of easy bulk edit features of other apps. Overall the inability to speak with a human will be the downfall. The company lacks the needed customer service.

body:
The bonus credits system makes zero sense. I got the 50 credits on sign up, made 3 orders of $5 each at the same time. It’s basically acting like if I have anything in the account it must be 50 credits first and then anything on top of that can be cash, instead of treating each order individually. 

The UI is nice though, so it gets a couple stars for that I guess.

title: My New GO-TO Camera!!!
body:
I was skeptical at first, that I needed a dedicated cam for my iPhone. I’ve always been fine with Apple’s native cameras and the latest one has some great new features.

However, as a photographer for the last 45 years… this ProCamera ii by Moment scratches all the itches I have when using a smart phone as a camera. It even has features that I didn’t know I needed.

I’ve known smart phone cameras would eventually replace legacy cameras for most use. I even published photo books using the iPhone 3. 

The original reason I bought this app is because it’s not subscription and it allows me to use and desqueeze anamorphic lenses, as well as import and bake LUTs into my images… but this app is so much more and does just about everything the way I’d do it if I was designing my own custom camera. 

At first I was hesitant that it didn’t support recording to external devices, but as soon as I pulled the trigger… an update came out that now supports external recording. For images too! And, it intelligently lets you specify where photos get saved as well as video… and remembers these settings unless you change it.

I love the free Blackmagic camera app for video, but more and more… I’m starting to favor this Moment app for video too. The interface is less cluttered and gets out of the way when you need it to.

Enthusiastically Highly Recommended!!!

title: Great app, Even better developers
body:
I have been using this app for quite a while to get past some of the apple-isms of the inbuilt camera app on iOS. This app has been amazing, to say the least. It unlocks pretty much every possible feature available (within the API's limits of course, we'll get back to that) and makes it all available in a fairly simple interface. 

Now - if you are new to photography and never used a proper DSLR or SLR film camera, many of the controls and features in this app will mean absolutely nothing to you. I suggest you keep at it and just play with the sittings (or look up a tutorial) because it is absolutely worth learning how to use these features, and Moment Pro Camera II makes it easy to access them. 

The auto-settings are pretty much identical to how Apple runs them (even down to the thing that lead me to buy this app - the LiDAR autofocus on iPhones focuses on your window rather than outside of the window!) but this app gives a darn easy interface for manually setting your focus! Something Apple doesn't even give you! This alone is amazing in general, and the fact that the developers went through the effort of adding a green glow to items currently in focus has been quite helpful for taking quick shots whilst on the move in full sunlight. 

Now, on that API thing; I noticed shooting video at 120fps caused it to shoot in slow-mo and reached out to the developers. Very promptly, the developers replied to me and explained what the issue was and how it was just a feature of how Apple runs the camera on the back-end. The developers spent a while researching it, and reached back out to me a few months later to tell me that they were unable to find a solution. It's so rare to find a developer team willing to take the time to do tech support in general, and it's even more rare to find a team willing to take the time to reach out to you months after your question was answered. 

I love the app, and I love the team behind it. If you're thinking of buying it, buy it. This app is well worth the purchase!

title: Devs are cooking 🔥 already beats Blackmagic
body:

Little by little it’s become my go-to for anything shot with intention (vlogs, stock footage, client shoots, slow shutter tracking), native camera still wins for short, last-minute grabs. Between this and Blackmagic Camera, Moment Pro 2 beta is winning me over, Blackmagic feels cluttered and buggier by comparison. I could see this becoming my only camera app before long. Stabilization in the beta feels smoother than before too, though unconfirmed, and I’m excited for the advanced stabilization update.

Overall, great experience and getting better fast.
